claim: Since this round a weather kind is live only while "its `hours` hold the view's hour" (V11 §3.25.11 *The columns*; base §6.1 in the same words), so the `hours` band now decides R and every draw. Neither *The kinds* (`mist` and `fog` 4–11, `shimmer` 10–18; l. 4664) nor §2.8's `hours?: [number, number]` says how a band holds an hour: whether the end hour b is live through its whole hour (fog at 11:30 under `light: 'time'`, whose `time` key counts hours, §2.9), whether a band with a > b wraps midnight (the week bands state "includes both ends and wraps the year's end when a > b"; the hours do not), or what range an edited `hours` cell is clamped to (no `range` is declared; V11 §4.1 clamps only to a declared range, and V12 §3.11 now places these cells under its default line). Two builders read the shipped cells differently, and an edit to, say, 20–8 for night fog has no defined outcome; EI-V11-EDGE-6 and T-V11-45 (v) carry neither case.
required_change: V11 §3.25.11 *The kinds*' head, after "in which the kind is live": "— whole hours of the view's day, each end in [0, 23] (its declared range): the kind is live while the hour of §2.9's `time` key, rounded down, lies in a … b, both ends included, wrapping midnight when a > b, as a band of weeks wraps the year's end"; §2.8's `hours` comment adds "whole hours 0–23, both ends included, a > b wrapping midnight"; EI-V11-EDGE-6 adds the case "an `hours` band with a > b; an edited end outside [0, 23]" with the outcome "wraps midnight; clamped into [0, 23] (V11 §4.1)", and T-V11-45 (v) adds both fixtures.
